The following events took place in '''4999 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] executes the [[Sith Council]] and eight thousand other Sith Lords through a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark]] [[Ritual of Nathema|ritual]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]].<ref name="Encyc" />
*Vitiate declares himself the new Emperor of the Sith and leads the remnants of the Empire on a [[Sith exodus|19-year odyssey]].<ref name="Encyc" />
